_about: Popular places listed in sitemap.xml as /search?lat&lng&place links (scripts/seo/build-seo.mjs). label is the page title place: "Parking near <label> | Where To Park". Each point was geocoded with Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) and checked by reverse geocoding to fall inside the named city or municipality. Keep 5 decimals. Edit, then redeploy the web app.
